assumptions: Each case uses one fixed energy, geometry, threshold, gates and array selection for unpolarized, polarized-reference and target samples.
Reference and target have one common linear Q for their explicitly matched physical P; this transfer is an assumption, not an experimental finding.
All six primitive category yields are independent Poisson variables; no background, event reuse or peak-fit covariance is asserted.
Reference P has an independent Gaussian local uncertainty; no real calibration transition is represented by its design value.
C in the SG98 design includes both confined categories including the side-ADC-zero category.
Monte Carlo is a finite-sample design validation, not a confidence interval for any experimental transition.
